why.en: Global package cache plus packages fetched on demand by npx. Deleting never touches installed dependencies; npm re-downloads on next use. _npx is usually the larger one.
why.zh: 全局包缓存，以及 npx 按需拉取的包。删除不影响已安装依赖，下次使用时重新下载。_npx 往往是更大的那一块。

why.en: pnpm keeps hard-linked package content here (macOS default: ~/Library/pnpm/store). If projects still use pnpm, pruning breaks their hard links and speeds suffer; safer to run `pnpm store prune`, which only removes unreferenced packages.
why.zh: pnpm 用硬链接存放包内容（macOS 默认在 ~/Library/pnpm/store）。如果还有项目在用 pnpm，整个清掉会破坏硬链接、下次安装变慢；更稳妥的是 `pnpm store prune`，只清理已无引用的包。

why.en: Downloaded package tarballs; rebuilt on the next install.
why.zh: 下载过的包压缩文件，下次安装会自动重建。

why.en: Wheel cache from pip install; re-downloaded when needed.
why.zh: pip install 下载的 wheel 缓存，需要时重新下载。

why.en: uv's global package cache. Existing virtualenvs keep working; uv re-downloads later.
why.zh: uv 的全局包缓存。已建好的虚拟环境不受影响，之后会自动重新下载。

name.zh: Homebrew 下载缓存与旧版本

why.en: Bottles and tarballs Homebrew downloaded. `brew cleanup` also removes old versions left behind by upgrades.
why.zh: Homebrew 下载过的 bottle / 源码包。`brew cleanup` 还会顺手清理升级后遗留的旧版本。

why.en: Crates downloaded from crates.io; the next build fetches them again.
why.zh: 从 crates.io 下载的 crate，下次构建会重新拉取。

why.en: Downloaded module zips and extracted sources; re-fetched on demand.
why.zh: 下载的模块压缩包与解压源码，需要时重新拉取。

why.en: Dependencies plus build caches. Your projects keep working, but the next build re-downloads and recompiles — noticeably slower.
why.zh: 依赖与构建缓存。项目不会坏，但下次构建需要重新下载与编译，会明显变慢。

why.en: Extracted package tarballs used to build conda envs. Envs themselves stay intact; future installs re-download what they need.
why.zh: 用于构建 conda 环境的解压包。已有环境不受影响，之后安装需要时再下载。

why.en: Local model weights. Deleting means re-downloading gigabytes, so CachePilot only shows the footprint. Use `ollama list` to see which models you actually still use, then `ollama rm <model>`.
why.zh: 本地模型权重文件。删掉要重新下载几个 GB，所以这里只展示占用。用 `ollama list` 看看哪些模型还在用，再用 `ollama rm <模型名>` 精确删除。

why.en: Models and datasets pulled from the Hub. They are re-downloadable, but that can be tens of GB — check which ones you still need first.
why.zh: 从 Hub 拉取的模型与数据集。可以重新下载，但可能几十 GB——先确认哪些还在用。

why.en: Run-time temporary files. The output/ and models/ folders are your work and are never touched.
why.zh: 运行时临时文件。output/ 与 models/ 是你的作品和模型，绝不触碰。

official_cmd.zh: 手动删除 temp 目录

why.en: Face-analysis models auto-downloaded on first use; re-downloaded automatically.
why.zh: 首次使用时自动下载的人脸分析模型，删掉后会自动重新下载。

name.zh: Docker Desktop 磁盘映像（仅展示）

why.en: Docker keeps images, containers and build cache inside this disk image. Moving the file would break Docker, so CachePilot only reports it. Prune inside Docker instead: dangling images and build cache are usually the biggest part.
why.zh: 镜像、容器与构建缓存都在这个磁盘映像里。移动文件会弄坏 Docker，所以只报占用。请在 Docker 内部清理：悬空镜像与构建缓存通常是最大头。

official_cmd.en: docker system prune -a --volumes, then shrink the disk image in Docker Desktop → Settings → Resources
official_cmd.zh: docker system prune -a --volumes，然后在 Docker Desktop → Settings → Resources 里收缩磁盘映像

why.en: Chromium/Firefox/WebKit builds downloaded for automation; re-installed with one command.
why.zh: 自动化测试下载的 Chromium/Firefox/WebKit，装回来只需一条命令。

official_cmd.en: npx playwright uninstall (reinstall: npx playwright install)
official_cmd.zh: npx playwright uninstall（重装：npx playwright install）

why.en: Anti-detection browser build; re-fetched by camoufox's installer.
why.zh: 反检测浏览器文件，重装 camoufox 时会重新下载。

why.en: Intermediate build products; Xcode rebuilds them (slower first build).
why.zh: 编译中间产物，Xcode 会重新生成（第一次编译会慢一些）。

official_cmd.en: xcodebuild clean, or delete the folder
official_cmd.zh: xcodebuild clean，或直接删除该目录

why.en: Debug symbols per iOS version and device; re-generated the next time you debug that device.
why.zh: 按 iOS 版本/设备缓存的调试符号，下次调试对应设备时会重新生成。

official_cmd.en: delete the folder in Xcode → Settings → Platforms / Devices
official_cmd.zh: 在 Xcode → Settings → Platforms/Devices 里删除，或手动删目录

name.zh: Xcode Archives（你打包发布的历史版本）

why.en: Archives are the .xcarchive bundles you uploaded to App Store Connect. Re-downloading them is not possible — check in Xcode Organizer before deleting.
why.zh: Archives 是你上传 App Store Connect 时的打包产物，删了无法重新下载——删之前先在 Xcode Organizer 里确认是否还需要。

official_cmd.zh: 在 Xcode → Window → Organizer 里管理

why.en: Chat history, received files and media — usually the single biggest folder on a work Mac. It contains messages you may need, so clean it inside WeChat, not with a file tool.
why.zh: 聊天记录、收到的文件与图片视频——往往是工作 Mac 上最大的一个目录。里面有聊天记录，请在微信内清理，不要用文件工具动。

official_cmd.zh: 微信 → 设置 → 通用 → 存储空间 → 管理

why.en: Preview and material cache. Your drafts live in User Data/Projects and are never touched.
why.zh: 预览与素材缓存。你的草稿在 User Data/Projects，绝不触碰。
